name: Dual-Mode Voxel Editing
definition: A workflow strategy that separates the representation of voxel data into two distinct modes to balance editing flexibility with rendering performance: 'View' mode for efficient mesh-based visualization and 'Edit' mode for voxel-level manipulation.
summary: Dual-Mode Voxel Editing balances performance by rendering most objects as static meshes while isolating heavy voxel-grid computation to a single active object in Edit mode.
